text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Um, the "plant that lets out a terrible 
scream when pulled from the ground" is... 
a man, mand, mandrill... No, that's not 
it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do the across clue first... 
'The name of the holy sword said to have 
been wielded by King Arthur'...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If I recall, ex... Deus ex machina? No, 
that's completely over the limit."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I wonder why my head just won't 
work properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire seems a little tired. It might 
be best to review her schedule.
